laws.rule: Domogled-Valea Cernei National Park: visit fee 2 euro plus VAT per person for 7 days (since 1 May 2023), from the Băile Herculane visitor centre or by SMS (about A$3.18 before VAT at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026).
laws.heading: Domogled-Valea Cernei

laws.rule: Domogled-Valea Cernei National Park: stay on marked trails; leaving them is an offence fined 3,000 to 6,000 lei for individuals (OUG 57/2007 art. 53). Camp only in signed areas; fires only in camping areas and near huts in purpose-built hearths; dogs on a lead and only on marked trails. (No RBA rate for RON; at the Banca Națională a României rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 3.355 RON: 3,000 lei ≈ A$894; 6,000 lei ≈ A$1,788)
laws.heading: Domogled-Valea Cernei
